scope.target_os: Windows Server 2012 R2/2016/2019/2022/2025; legacy modules are retained only when they map to service fingerprints or patch checks.
scope.target_service: Windows Server network services: IIS/HTTP.sys/WebDAV/WSUS/Web Deploy, SMB, RDP, MSMQ, RPC/Print Spooler, Netlogon/AD CS, Exchange, SharePoint, SSRS, database, SSH, TLS, and selected third-party Windows server services.
scope.module_policy: Load only service-facing Metasploit modules found in the uploaded CVE inventory. DoS, local privilege escalation, client-side/fileformat, non-Windows, network appliance, and unrelated web-app modules are excluded. Exploit modules must be invoked with check only; if check is unavailable, fall back to local service/patch validation and skip execution.
scope.execution_mode: local USB audit: MSFRPC safe scanner/check plus PowerShell service, feature, registry, file-version, and patch checks
notes: Input CVE inventory contained 1643 entries; only runnable module-like, service-facing Windows Server candidates are retained.
The previous IIS-only scope was widened to Windows Server service scan; IIS remains one service family, not the whole profile.
Auxiliary scanner/gather modules may run with low thread count. Exploit modules are never executed with run/exploit in default mode; use check only when available.
DoS modules such as HTTP.sys crash/resource-exhaustion checks are represented as local-only patch checks.
Third-party products are marked service_required=false and should run only when the local service/fingerprint/port indicates the product exists.

modules.name: Microsoft IIS HTTP Internal IP Disclosure
modules.server_2022_relevance: Safe low-impact IIS HTTP fingerprint/misconfiguration check; mark not_applicable if W3SVC/HTTP is absent.

local_check.patch_guidance: Verify IIS redirect/alternateHostName configuration and keep Windows Server cumulative updates current.

modules.expected_signal: Reports whether IIS redirects or HTTP responses disclose an internal IP address.

modules.name: CVE-2015-1635 HTTP.sys Range header vulnerability safe local check
modules.server_2022_relevance: HTTP.sys is a Windows Server kernel HTTP listener used by IIS and other HTTP services. The Metasploit DoS module is intentionally not executed.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install MS15-034 / the relevant Windows Server cumulative update; never run active DoS probes in default audit mode.

modules.expected_signal: Reports HTTP.sys file version, Windows hotfix/cumulative update posture, and whether HTTP/W3SVC is running.

modules.name: CVE-2021-31166 HTTP.sys Accept-Encoding RCE/DoS safe local check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant when HTTP.sys/IIS is listening on Windows Server. The available Metasploit module is DoS-oriented, so the profile keeps only patch/service validation.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the May 2021 or later Windows Server cumulative update; do not execute crash-oriented HTTP.sys tests.

modules.expected_signal: Reports HTTP.sys version/patch posture without sending crash payloads.

modules.name: Windows Server Update Service Deserialization Remote Code Execution
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant when WSUS is installed on Windows Server and ports 8530/8531 are exposed. Execute only Metasploit check; never run exploit in default scan.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the Windows Server/WSUS update that remediates CVE-2025-59287.

modules.expected_signal: Reports WSUS endpoint reachability, Metasploit check output, and local WSUS patch/service posture.

modules.name: SMBv3 Compression Buffer Overflow
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to Windows Server SMBv3 exposure on TCP/445. Use check mode/local patch validation only.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the March 2020 SMBv3 update and ensure SMB compression mitigation is applied where applicable.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SMB port reachability, SMBv3/compression exposure when check is supported, and local srv2.sys patch posture.

modules.name: MS08-067 Microsoft Server Service Relative Path Stack Corruption
modules.server_2022_relevance: Legacy Windows Server service CVE retained for fingerprint matching on old hosts; should be not_applicable on Windows Server 2022+.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install MS08-067 / cumulative updates; modern Windows Server should report not_applicable.

modules.expected_signal: Reports only legacy SMB Server Service exposure/check result; no exploit run.

modules.name: CVE-2019-0708 BlueKeep Microsoft Remote Desktop RCE Check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Safe RDP BlueKeep scanner for TCP/3389; exploit module is excluded from default service scan.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the May 2019 BlueKeep security update; enable NLA and restrict RDP exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports whether RDP appears vulnerable to BlueKeep and local TermService patch posture.

modules.name: CVE-2023-21554 - QueueJumper - MSMQ RCE Check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant when Microsoft Message Queuing is installed and TCP/1801 is reachable.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the April 2023 Windows Server cumulative update or remove/disable MSMQ when unused.

modules.expected_signal: Reports MSMQ endpoint reachability/check result and local MSMQ service/feature/patch posture.

modules.name: CVE-2021-1675/CVE-2021-34527 Print Spooler safe local check
modules.server_2022_relevance: The source file contains a Print Spooler exploit module, but remote DLL injection is not safe for service audit; local service/policy/patch checks are used instead.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install PrintNightmare updates; disable Print Spooler on servers that do not require printing; restrict PointAndPrint policy.

modules.expected_signal: Reports Spooler service state, PointAndPrint policy posture, and patch indicators without loading a DLL.

modules.name: CVE-2020-1472 Netlogon Zerologon safe local check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only on Domain Controllers. The Metasploit admin module can reset machine account secrets, so this profile uses local patch/role checks only.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install Zerologon updates and enforce secure RPC on domain controllers.

modules.expected_signal: Reports whether host is a DC/Netlogon server and whether the secure RPC patch/policy posture is present.

modules.name: CVE-2022-26923 AD CS Certifried safe local check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant when Active Directory Certificate Services is installed. The Metasploit module performs certificate abuse, so default scan only checks service/patch posture.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the May 2022 security update and review AD CS template/domain controller certificate mapping settings.

modules.expected_signal: Reports AD CS service/role presence and patch/policy indicators.

modules.name: Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon RCE
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant when Microsoft Exchange Server OWA/ECP is exposed over HTTP/HTTPS.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install March 2021 or later Exchange security updates and verify OWA/ECP exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports Exchange HTTP endpoint fingerprint/check result when supported and local Exchange service/patch posture.

modules.name: Microsoft Exchange ProxyShell RCE
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to Exchange Client Access services exposed over HTTP/HTTPS.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install July/August 2021 or later Exchange security updates.

modules.expected_signal: Reports Exchange ProxyShell check/fingerprint output and local Exchange patch indicators.

modules.name: Microsoft Exchange ProxyNotShell RCE
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to Exchange OWA/ECP/PowerShell HTTP endpoints.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install November 2022 or later Exchange security updates and restrict remote PowerShell exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports ProxyNotShell endpoint/check output and local Exchange patch posture.

modules.name: Exchange Control Panel ViewState Deserialization
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to Exchange ECP endpoints over HTTP/HTTPS.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install February 2020 or later Exchange security updates and rotate Exchange validation keys if needed.

modules.expected_signal: Reports ECP reachability/check output and Exchange patch/config posture.

modules.name: Microsoft SharePoint Server ToolPane Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (aka ToolShell)
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to Microsoft SharePoint Server web front-end services.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the SharePoint security update that remediates the ToolShell chain and verify web front-end patch level.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SharePoint endpoint/check output when supported and local SharePoint service/patch posture.

modules.name: Sharepoint Dynamic Proxy Generator Unauth RCE
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to Microsoft SharePoint Server web applications exposed over HTTP/HTTPS.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install June 2023 or later SharePoint security updates.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SharePoint dynamic proxy check output when supported and local patch/service posture.

modules.name: SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) ViewState Deserialization
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant to SQL Server Reporting Services web portals exposed over HTTP/HTTPS.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the February 2020 SQL Server Reporting Services security update or later.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SSRS endpoint/check output and local SSRS service/patch posture.

modules.name: MySQL Authentication Bypass Password Dump
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if MySQL/MariaDB is installed on the Windows Server; skip when port 3306 is closed.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade MySQL/MariaDB to a fixed version and restrict database exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports MySQL service reachability/auth-bypass check result and local version/service posture when installed.

modules.name: PostgreSQL Database Name Command Line Flag Injection
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if PostgreSQL is installed on the Windows Server; skip when port 5432 is closed.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade PostgreSQL to a fixed version and restrict database exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports PostgreSQL reachability/check result and local PostgreSQL version posture when installed.

modules.name: MongoDB Memory Disclosure (CVE-2025-14847) - Mongobleed
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if MongoDB is installed on the Windows Server; skip when port 27017 is closed.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade MongoDB to a version fixed for CVE-2025-14847 and restrict database exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports MongoDB reachability/check output and local version posture when installed.

modules.name: libssh Authentication Bypass Scanner
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if an SSH service using libssh is present. Windows OpenSSH normally should not match, but this keeps service scan coverage broad.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade libssh/OpenSSH components; skip if Windows OpenSSH does not use vulnerable libssh.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SSH fingerprint/auth-bypass scanner output and local SSH service/version posture.

modules.name: SSH Username Enumeration
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant if SSH is enabled on the Windows Server. Use low thread count and local authorization only.

local_check.patch_guidance: Patch OpenSSH and restrict SSH exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SSH enumeration/fingerprint posture only when SSH is present.

modules.name: SSL/TLS Version Detection
modules.server_2022_relevance: Generic TLS service posture check for HTTPS/LDAPS/RDP gateway/SMTP TLS services hosted on Windows Server.

local_check.patch_guidance: Disable SSLv2/SSLv3/TLS 1.0/TLS 1.1 where policy requires; prefer TLS 1.2/1.3 and strong cipher suites.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SSL/TLS protocol/cipher posture and maps findings to known weak-protocol CVEs carried by the Metasploit module.

modules.name: Progress Software WS_FTP Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if Progress WS_FTP Server is installed on the Windows Server.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade WS_FTP Server to a fixed version; restrict admin/web interface exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports WS_FTP HTTP endpoint/check output and local service/version posture when installed.

modules.name: MOVEit SQL Injection vulnerability
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if MOVEit Transfer is installed on the Windows Server.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade MOVEit Transfer to a fixed version and check for compromise indicators.

modules.expected_signal: Reports MOVEit endpoint/check output and local service/version posture when installed.

modules.name: SolarWinds Serv-U Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Read
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if SolarWinds Serv-U FTP/MFT Server is installed on the Windows Server. Read-only gather module; keep target file/path constrained by policy.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade SolarWinds Serv-U to a fixed version and restrict web interface exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports Serv-U endpoint reachability/file-read check posture and local service/version presence.

modules.name: CrushFTP Unauthenticated RCE
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if CrushFTP is installed on the Windows Server.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade CrushFTP to a fixed version and restrict admin/web interface exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports CrushFTP endpoint/check output and local service/version posture when installed.

modules.name: SmarterTools SmarterMail less than build 6985 - .NET Deserialization Remote Code Execution
modules.server_2022_relevance: Relevant only if SmarterTools SmarterMail is installed on the Windows Server.

local_check.patch_guidance: Upgrade SmarterMail to a fixed build and restrict webmail/admin exposure.

modules.expected_signal: Reports SmarterMail endpoint/check output and local service/version posture when installed.

modules.name: SMB Signing Is Not Required Detection
modules.server_2022_relevance: Checks if the remote SMB server requires packet signing, which prevents SMB relay attacks.

local_check.patch_guidance: Enforce SMB signing in Windows group policy (Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always) = Enabled).

modules.expected_signal: Reports signatures:optional or SMB Signing Is Not Required in Metasploit output or registry check.

pymetasploit3_runner_template.description: Load each module via MSFRPC, override target/port options, run auxiliary scanner/gather modules with run, and run exploit modules with check only. If an exploit module does not implement check, skip it and use the local_check block.
pseudo_code: for k, v in default_datastore.items(): mod[k] = v
elif module_type == 'local': run PowerShell local_check only
if check is not supported or target service is absent: mark skipped/not_applicable; do not exploit
